name: CHARMS Silver
description: Pointed silver star motifs and clear rectangular centres bring ECHO's sculptural design language into a decorative accessory.
fullDescription: CHARMS translates the star motif into a smaller ornamental form. Silver-toned points surround clear rectangular centres, combining sharp outlines with a jewellery-inspired appearance. The design echoes the decorative details found across ECHO's earbud collection, making it a visual continuation of the same sharp, sculptural design language. Its small-scale silhouette brings that character into the accessory collection.
